name: XP-08
description: XP-08: an XP-80 style PCM synthesizer that plays Roland SR-JV80 expansion boards from your own dumps (in roms/), with the JV-1080 and JV-880 internal waves from your own dumps too. Four board slots, the boards' own patches, four tones per patch with pitch, filter and amp envelopes, two LFOs, matrix control; three filter models; all 40 EFX types, chorus and reverb.
author: Stephane Schmitz
